task_message:
Case N48: segment the peripheral nerve sheath tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 176x176x165 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text: Case N48 is finished. The final mask (v2, 28.7 mL, single component) outlines the T2-hyperintense fusiform peripheral nerve sheath tumor in the limb, following its heterogeneous periphery across all three planes. The review confirmed no lesion tissue beyond either end of the mask, and the only intensity-based candidate (C1) was a separate vascular/fascial structure not contiguous with the mass, so it was rejected. Confidence: medium (boundary verified in three planes around the solid mass, with some ambiguity at the tapered ends where tumor blends with peritumoral signal).
